libdeflate attribution

The supplied ragg native library contains statically linked libdeflate code.
LICENSE.libdeflate reproduces upstream libdeflate's copyright and MIT permission
notice, including both copyright holders recorded in the reviewed upstream
COPYING history. The exact libdeflate version in the supplied binary has not
been established; this notice does not assert a version or source-to-binary match.

Upstream project: https://github.com/ebiggers/libdeflate
Notice source: https://github.com/ebiggers/libdeflate/blob/439f30117684c7859e0b1d4d8c57306b9ad71fd4/COPYING

The notice applies to libdeflate; other bundled components retain their own
copyrights and licences.
